title: Columbina: the lines of a session file and the chunks of a reply
description: Made from the code by tests/support/protocol.py. Do not change it by hand: run the tests with COLUMBINA_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1.

ApprovalPolicyEvent.description: The policy of a session was set.
ApprovalPolicyEvent.title: ApprovalPolicyEvent

AsideEvent.description:
A request to a model that is no part of the conversation.

A summary of the conversation is asked for in this way. What the model
answers is not shown to it as something it said, so there is no message
here. But the request cost what any request costs, and that is what this
event is for.

Attributes:
    purpose: What the request was made for, in a word.
    usage: What it cost.
    failure: Why it failed, if it did.
AsideEvent.title: AsideEvent

AssistantAttemptEvent.description: A call to the model that failed. ``message`` holds what had arrived.
AssistantAttemptEvent.title: AssistantAttemptEvent

AssistantMessageEvent.description:
A reply of the model.

``finish_reason`` is ``None`` for a reply that was interrupted, in which
case ``message`` holds what had arrived.
AssistantMessageEvent.title: AssistantMessageEvent

BlockStart.description: A new content block begins. A tool call carries its id and name here.
BlockStart.title: BlockStart

CallConfig.description:
Everything about one call that is not the conversation.

A field left as ``None`` is not sent, and the provider's default applies.
The whole config is written to the session log with each request, so a
run can be reproduced from the log.

Attributes:
    provider: The name under which the adapter is registered.
    model: The model identifier, in the provider's own spelling.
    context_window: The size of the model's context window, in tokens.
    max_output_tokens: The limit on the length of the reply.
    temperature: The sampling temperature.
    top_p: The nucleus sampling threshold.
    seed: The sampling seed, for providers that honour one.
    reasoning: How much the model should reason before it answers.
    options: Further settings that only one adapter understands.
CallConfig.title: CallConfig

CompactionEndEvent.description:
Making a conversation shorter is over.

Attributes:
    why: What it was done for.
    outcome: How it ended.
CompactionEndEvent.title: CompactionEndEvent

CompactionStartEvent.description:
A conversation is about to be made shorter.

Attributes:
    why: What it is done for.
    tokens: What the messages come to, in tokens as they are estimated.
CompactionStartEvent.title: CompactionStartEvent

CompactionSummaryEvent.description:
A summary was written. The message that carries it comes next.

Attributes:
    summary: The summary, as the model that wrote it gave it.
    replaces: The events whose messages it is to take the place of.
    region_tokens: What those messages came to, as estimated.
    summary_tokens: What the message that carries the summary comes to.
    usage: What the request for the summary cost.
CompactionSummaryEvent.title: CompactionSummaryEvent

EndSeedEvent.description:
The boundary between history that was taken over and work of this lifetime.

``inherited`` is true when the history comes from another session.
EndSeedEvent.title: EndSeedEvent

Finish.description: The reply is over. ``failure`` is set exactly when the reason is ``error``.
Finish.title: Finish

HookInvokedEvent.description:
A hook is about to run.

Attributes:
    event: The moment that it runs for.
    command: Its command.
HookInvokedEvent.title: HookInvokedEvent

HookResultEvent.description:
A hook has run.

Attributes:
    event: The moment that it ran for.
    command: Its command.
    status: How the run ended.
    exit_code: The exit code of the command, if it came to its end.
    duration_ms: How long the run took.
    reason: Why the hook stops something or wants somebody asked, if it
        does.
HookResultEvent.title: HookResultEvent

InboxItem.description:
One input that waits for an agent.

Attributes:
    message: What the model will read.
    source: Where the input comes from, as in ``UserMessageEvent``.
InboxItem.title: InboxItem

InboxSplicedEvent.description: A queue of the inbox changed: items left at its front, or joined at its end.
InboxSplicedEvent.title: InboxSplicedEvent

Item.description:
One thing to do.

Attributes:
    content: What is to be done, on one line.
    status: How far it has come.
Item.title: Item

LlmFailure.description:
Why a call to a model failed.

Attributes:
    message: A description for people.
    code: A stable code for programs, such as ``RATE_LIMIT``.
    status: The HTTP status, when the failure came with one.
    retry_after_ms: How long the provider asked the caller to wait.
    request_id: The provider's identifier of the request.
LlmFailure.title: LlmFailure

Outcome.description:
How making a conversation shorter ended.

Attributes:
    trimmed: How many results of tools were cut down to their ends.
    summarised: How many messages a summary took the place of, or 0 if
        none was written.
    before: What the messages came to before, in tokens as they are
        estimated.
    after: What they came to afterwards.
    error: Why it did not do all that it set out to do, or ``None``.
        What was trimmed by then stays trimmed.
Outcome.title: Outcome

ReasoningBlock.description:
Reasoning that a model produced before its answer.

``replay_state`` belongs to the adapter that produced the block. It is sent
back unchanged with the next request, and only to that adapter.
ReasoningBlock.title: ReasoningBlock

ReasoningDelta.description: More text for a reasoning block.
ReasoningDelta.title: ReasoningDelta

RequestHeaderEvent.description: The call config and the tool schemas that the following requests use.
RequestHeaderEvent.title: RequestHeaderEvent

RetryEvent.description:
A request is about to be made again.

The event is written before the wait begins. A reader that does not know
it may skip it: it changes nothing about the conversation.

Attributes:
    turn: The number of the turn.
    step: The number of the step in that turn.
    attempt: Which attempt of the step failed, counted from 1.
    code: The code of the failure.
    delay_ms: The wait before the next attempt.
RetryEvent.title: RetryEvent

SandboxModeEvent.description: The mode of a session was set.
SandboxModeEvent.title: SandboxModeEvent

SessionHeader.description:
The first line of a session file.

Attributes:
    type: Always ``session``.
    version: The version of the file format.
    id: The id of the session.
    created_at: When the session was created, in milliseconds since the epoch.
    cwd: The working directory that the session was created in.
    parent_session: The id of the session that this one comes from: the
        one it is a copy of, or the one whose agent delegated to it.
    delegation_depth: How many agents stand between a person and the
        agent of this session. It is 0 for a conversation, and one more
        than that of its parent for the session of a subagent. A file
        that says nothing about it was written for a conversation.
SessionHeader.title: SessionHeader

StepStartEvent.description: A step begins: one request to the model and the tool calls it leads to.
StepStartEvent.title: StepStartEvent

SubagentEndedEvent.description:
A subagent has ended. This is written into the log of its parent.

Attributes:
    call_id: The id of the call that handed the task over.
    session_id: The id of the session of the subagent.
    reason: Why its turn ended, in the words of the end of a turn, or
        ``unknown`` if nobody can say.
    detail: More about the reason, as its own log has it.
    steps: How many steps its turn took.
SubagentEndedEvent.title: SubagentEndedEvent

SubagentStartedEvent.description:
A subagent has started. This is written into the log of its parent.

Attributes:
    call_id: The id of the call that handed the task over.
    session_id: The id of the session of the subagent.
    kind: The kind of the subagent, if the call named one.
    description: What the task is, in a few words for a person.
SubagentStartedEvent.title: SubagentStartedEvent

SurfaceOp.description: Present if the event carries a message that the model sees. The message is appended to the conversation, or it takes the place of the messages of the events that source_event_seqs lists.

SystemMessage.description: The instructions that open a conversation.
SystemMessage.title: SystemMessage

SystemMessageEvent.description: The system prompt as it was rendered.
SystemMessageEvent.title: SystemMessageEvent

TextDelta.description: More text for a text block.
TextDelta.title: TextDelta

TodoWriteEvent.description:
The list was written. It takes the place of the list before it.

Attributes:
    call_id: The call that wrote it. The model sees the list for as long
        as it sees the reply that made that call.
    items: The things to do, in the order in which they were given.
TodoWriteEvent.title: TodoWriteEvent

ToolCallBlock.description:
A request by the model to call a tool.

``arguments`` is the JSON text exactly as the model produced it. It is not
parsed or repaired on the way.
ToolCallBlock.title: ToolCallBlock

ToolCallDelta.description: More of the JSON text of a tool call's arguments.
ToolCallDelta.title: ToolCallDelta

ToolCallEvent.description: A tool call is about to be dispatched, with the arguments as the model wrote them.
ToolCallEvent.title: ToolCallEvent

ToolError.description:
Why a tool call did not succeed, for programs.

Attributes:
    code: A stable code, such as ``UNKNOWN_TOOL``.
    reason: A description for people.
ToolError.title: ToolError

ToolMessage.description: The result of one tool call, as the model sees it.
ToolMessage.title: ToolMessage

ToolResultEvent.description:
The result of a tool call.

Attributes:
    message: The result as the model sees it.
    error: Set when the call did not succeed.
    meta: Facts about the call that the model does not see.
ToolResultEvent.title: ToolResultEvent

ToolSchema.description:
What a model is told about one tool.

``parameters`` is a JSON Schema object describing the arguments.
ToolSchema.title: ToolSchema

TurnEndEvent.description: A turn is over. ``detail`` says more about the reason, such as who cancelled.
TurnEndEvent.title: TurnEndEvent

Usage.description:
The token counts of one call. The four counts do not overlap.

``input_tokens`` counts only the input that was not read from a cache.
Usage.title: Usage

UsageChunk.description: The token counts so far. A later one replaces an earlier one.
UsageChunk.title: UsageChunk

UserMessage.description: Input from the person, or context that is supplied on their behalf.
UserMessage.title: UserMessage

UserMessageEvent.description:
Input for the model in the role of the user.

``source`` says where the input came from. ``user`` is what the person
typed, or for a subagent what the agent wrote that handed it its task.
Other sources mark input that was supplied on their behalf.
UserMessageEvent.title: UserMessageEvent
